# Filament Games

> Filament Games is a veteran educational game developer creating game-based learning experiences for schools, museums, and educational institutions through partnerships with organizations like Amazon, Scholastic, Smithsonian, and iCivics.

Founded on the principle that games can meaningfully improve learning outcomes, Filament Games specializes in designing accessible, research-backed educational games across STEM, civics, health, and life skills domains. The company combines game design expertise with educational theory to create engaging digital learning tools.

## Key Topics

- Educational games
- Game-based learning (GBL)
- Serious games
- Learning outcomes

## Game-Based Learning Insights

- [Building Accessible Educational Games: Lessons from the Front Lines](https://www.filamentgames.com/blog/building-accessible-educational-games-lessons-from-the-front-lines): Blog post on WCAG 2.1 AA compliance for educational games with case studies and accessibility retrofitting lessons.
- [Accessibility in Educational Games: What the Law Requires (and What Comes Next)](https://www.filamentgames.com/blog/accessibility-in-educational-games-what-the-law-requires-and-what-comes-next): Blog explaining federal accessibility laws (ADA, Section 508, ESSA) affecting educational games and web content.
- [GBL Luminary Guest Post: What is Academically Meaningful Play?](https://www.filamentgames.com/blog/gbl-luminary-guest-post-what-is-academically-meaningful-play): Guest post from Douglas B. Clark on academically meaningful play and game design theory.
- [GBL Luminary Guest Post: A Logical Journey Through Game-Based Learning](https://www.filamentgames.com/blog/gbl-luminary-guest-post-a-logical-journey-through-game-based-learning): Guest post from Jodi Asbell-Clarke on game-based learning, neurodiversity, and learning assessment.
